<section id="wellness">
  <div class="container">
    <div class="section-head">
      <div class="eyebrow">Men’s wellness education</div>
      <h2>Understanding prostate enlargement.</h2>
      <p>Benign prostatic hyperplasia (BPH), also called benign prostate enlargement, is a non-cancerous enlargement of the prostate. As it grows, it can press on the urethra and contribute to lower urinary tract symptoms, and it becomes more common with age.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="cards">
      <article class="card"><div class="icon">01</div><h3>Associated factors</h3><p>Age-related changes in prostate tissue and male hormone levels, family history, and certain medical conditions and lifestyle factors may be associated with prostate enlargement.</p></article>
      <article class="card"><div class="icon">02</div><h3>Common symptoms</h3><p>Difficulty starting urination, weak, slow or interrupted flow, frequent or urgent urination, waking at night, incomplete emptying and dribbling after urination.</p></article>
      <article class="card"><div class="icon">03</div><h3>When to seek medical attention</h3><p>Blood in urine, significant pain, fever or inability to urinate requires prompt medical attention. Urinary symptoms can also have causes other than BPH.</p></article>
    </div>
    
  </div>
</section>

<script>
function toggleMenu(){
  const nav=document.getElementById('navLinks');
  const btn=document.querySelector('.menu-btn');
  const open=nav.classList.toggle('open');
  btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded',open?'true':'false');
}
function closeMenu(){document.getElementById('navLinks').classList.remove('open');document.querySelector('.menu-btn').setAttribute('aria-expanded','false')}
function sendWhatsApp(e){
  e.preventDefault();
  const name=document.getElementById('name').value.trim();
  const message=document.getElementById('message').value.trim();
  const text=encodeURIComponent(`Hello Harbavelle, my name is ${name}. ${message}`);
  window.open(`https://wa.me/2347085652096?text=${text}`,'_blank');
}
